scope: Current intracranial anatomy and source cranial-bone/cavity context. Whole-body, dedicated eye/ear/dental/maxillofacial and artificial source annotations are not added. The source remains a conceptual anatomical model, not native MRI/CT or an individual case cohort.
geometry_sharing: No source names or left/right counterparts are deduplicated merely because they share mesh data or bilateral symmetry; accepted source objects retain distinct authored names and transforms. Duplicate display encodings do not create additional cases.
completeness_limit: All7184 source objects partitioned by declared current scope;5520 areMESH/CURVE. This is not a claim of complete human neuroanatomy, and external/out-of-scope objects have not received full anatomical validation.
